title: two Error classes with the same name in one module cannot both receive a stable nominal identity
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Error Classes', requires the compiler to 'provide stable nominal identity, matching metadata, serialization evidence, and cross-realm transport metadata'. poc/src/language/README.md records that stable ids are module/name based, so two same-named Error classes in one module would collide; the fail-closed answer is SMITHERS1150. 04-nominal-errors/same-named-errors-in-two-modules pins the other side: the same name in two *different* modules is fine, because row members are module-qualified.
